subject: NexusBridge integration — MSA & SOW redlines and go-live dependencies
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@nexusbridge.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@nexusbridge.com
Date: 2026-06-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed MSA and SOW for NexusBridge integration

Hi Vanessa / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — NexusBridge is excited about the connector and the low-latency inference profile you showed. Attached are our draft MSA with a few redlines and the current SOW (v1.2) that outlines the integration milestones and responsibilities. High-level asks from our side:

- Clarify data handling: we requested explicit language on ephemeral KV cache retention and non-persistence of customer prompt data.
- SLA targets: we proposed 99.5% availability for the dedicated connector during business hours with remedies.
- IP carveouts: typical for our ISV platform (see section 6).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept the limited retention language and the proposed remedies? If not, what counter language would be acceptable?

We'd like to move to a procurement-ready version by end of next week if possible.

Attached: NexusBridge_MSA_redlines.docx, NexusBridge_SOW_v1.2.pdf

Best,
Elaine Park
Head of Partnerships (Commercial) — NexusBridge
Elaine Park
elain.park@nexusbridge.com
+1 (415) 555-0189
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@nexusbridge.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed MSA and SOW for NexusBridge integration

Hi Elaine — thanks for sending these over and for the clear asks. Looping in Karthik (commercial lead) and Sergio (partnerships ops) and Laura for contracts review.

Quick responses to your bullets:
- Data handling: Redwood's standard practice is ephemeral KV/cache retention for inference-only integrations; we do not persist customer prompt bodies unless customers enable logging for evals. Laura — I flagged the relevant MSA clause to match.
- SLA: We can commit to a 99.5% target for the dedicated connector during agreed-upon business hours, but remedies should be limited to service credits (no liability cap increases).
- IP carveouts: we'll need specifics on NexusBridge's requested carveouts.

Would you be open to a short 30-min sync tomorrow to walk through the high-level redlines and align on a procurement timeline? I can run through the commercial tradeoffs live so procurement has what they need.

I attached a one-page redline summary (redline-summary-vanessa.xlsx) that consolidates the topics Redwood is likely to accept vs. those requiring legal approval.

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@nexusbridge.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T10:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed MSA and SOW for NexusBridge integration

On Tue, Jun 15, 2026 at 11:03 AM vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com> wrote:
> Hi Elaine — thanks for sending these over and for the clear asks. Looping in Karthik (commercial lead) and Sergio (partnerships ops) and Laura for contracts review.

Thanks — I reviewed the redlines and left inline comments in the Doc (shared link below). Primary legal positions we'd expect to hold:

1) Data retention: Accept the ephemeral language as long as NexusBridge confirms no downstream storage by default and that any logging is opt-in per account. We added a one-sentence clarifier to Section 4.2.
2) SLA & remedies: We will accept a 99.5% uptime objective for the dedicated connector with service-credit remedies capped at monthly fees for the connector, and the overall liability cap remains as in Redwood's standard MSA. We cannot expand indemnity or remove consequential damage waivers.
3) IP: We can accept a limited license for NexusBridge to use Redwood API responses as part of their product but will not assign ownership of Redwood models or core runtime. Proposed language in Section 6.1.

Next steps I recommend:
- Vanessa/Karthik: confirm whether NexusBridge requires any on-prem or VPC option in the SOW (that impacts timelines).
- Sergio: please confirm scaling needs — expected concurrent connections and tokens/sec so we can size dedicated capacity in SOW milestones.
- Elaine: if procurement needs a marked-up DocuSign, we can prepare a procurement-ready copy after the sync.

Shared comment thread: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cNexusBridge-Contracts

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Contracts Counsel — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@nexusbridge.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed MSA and SOW for NexusBridge integration

Thanks Laura — that helps a lot and aligns with what our procurement team expects.

Confirmed items:
- NexusBridge does not require retention by default; logging will be an opt-in feature per account.
- We can accept the service-credit only remedy for SLA breaches.
- No IP assignment requested; the limited license language is acceptable.

Action items:
1) Schedule 30-min sync tomorrow (2026-06-19) at 10:00 AM PT to finalize procurement-ready copy.
2) Vanessa/Karthik: please confirm whether the SOW should include a VPC deployment option (NexusBridge will evaluate but wants pricing if runway requires on-prem/VPC).
3) Sergio: I'll share expected concurrent connection and token/sec numbers by tomorrow morning to help size dedicated capacity.

Once we align on these, procurement will request a DocuSign-ready version (we'll send PO once DocuSign is complete). Please send the final marked-up MSA to contracts@nexusbridge.com and I will pull procurement into the DocuSign request.

Best,
Elaine Park
Head of Partnerships — NexusBridge
